# BioKids' boot menu on an installed computer (D-255), as the stick's (D-252):
# the logo high on the deep indigo, the menu in the logo's typeface, Fredoka,
# and the selected item on an amber pill. biokids-desktop copies this folder to
# /boot/grub/themes/biokids, where GRUB reads it before any disk is unlocked.
#
# GRUB crops background.png to the screen's shape around its middle, so on any
# screen up to 16:9 the logo keeps its share of the height, and the menu is
# placed in shares of the height below it. GRUB's fonts are bitmaps and do not
# scale: debian/rules makes Fredoka at 18 and 24 pixels, named
# "<name> Regular <size>", and the pill's round ends are drawn for an item
# 48 pixels high (dev/make_icons.py).
#
# The words are GRUB's own, translated into the language update-grub ran in:
# @KEYMAP_SHORT@ ("enter: boot, `e': options, `c': cmd-line") and the
# countdown, @TIMEOUT_NOTIFICATION_MIDDLE@ ("%ds remaining."), which shows
# only while the menu counts down - beside Windows (D-252).

title-text: ""
desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-image-scale-method: "crop"
desktop-image-h-align: "center"
desktop-image-v-align: "center"
desktop-color: "#1f224d"
message-font: "Fredoka Regular 18"
message-color: "#fbf7f2"
# Editing an entry ("e") and the command line ("c") keep GRUB's own
# fixed-width font, which Debian's grub.cfg loads before the theme's.
terminal-font: "Unifont Regular 16"

# The menu: the off-white of every BioKids screen on the indigo, the selected
# item in the indigo on amber. No icons, and no scroll bar: a computer beside
# Windows has four entries, and the list scrolls with the arrow keys anyway.
+ boot_menu {
    left = 30%-75
    width = 40%+150
    top = 36%
    height = 64%-150
    item_font = "Fredoka Regular 24"
    item_color = "#fbf7f2"
    selected_item_font = "Fredoka Medium Regular 24"
    selected_item_color = "#1f224d"
    selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"
    item_height = 48
    item_padding = 0
    item_spacing = 8
    icon_width = 0
    icon_height = 0
    item_icon_space = 12
    scrollbar = false
}

# The countdown, filling in --bio-indigo; GRUB draws it only while it runs.
+ progress_bar {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 50%-170
    width = 340
    top = 100%-118
    height = 32
    font = "Fredoka Regular 18"
    text = "@TIMEOUT_NOTIFICATION_MIDDLE@"
    text_color = "#fbf7f2"
    fg_color = "#4b54c8"
    bg_color = "#2e3270"
    border_color = "#2e3270"
}

# The keys, in a quieter lavender.
+ label {
    left = 0
    width = 100%
    top = 100%-62
    height = 28
    align = "center"
    font = "Fredoka Regular 18"
    color = "#a9acd8"
    text = "@KEYMAP_SHORT@"
}
